hotels.name: Novotel Paris Nord Expo Villepinte
reviews: Walking distance to the exhibition halls, easy check-in.
Rooms are standard but clean; staff stored our equipment cases without fuss.
Shuttle to CDG runs every 20 minutes.

hotels.name: Hotel ibis Paris CDG Airport
reviews: Right next to the terminal train, good for early flights.
Small rooms, but quiet and inexpensive.
Breakfast opens at 4:30, handy for red-eyes.

hotels.name: Hôtel Le Marais Saint-Paul
reviews: Charming boutique hotel in the heart of the Marais.
Tiny elevator, but lovely rooms and very helpful front desk.
About an hour by RER to the airport.

cars.name: Hertz Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport
cars.address: Terminal 2, Gare TGV level, 95700 Roissy-en-France, France
reviews: Quick pickup with Gold status, car was ready at the counter.
Plenty of trunk space in the estate models for luggage and cases.
